note: Rules for Jobsite Intelligence, same schema as ASI's ops/rules.json, read by scripts/ji_ops.py. Sender (user, Oct 14): every metro sends from sites@asterfieldgroup.com with its own display name, "[City] Jobsite Intelligence"; Houston only for now because a manifest maps one display name per address. The tracker wins over this file.
standard_price_line: The sample costs nothing; after it, our 30-day pilot is a one-time $500 for 15–20 verified projects, with no subscription.

refund_allowed.note: No refund exceptions in this business.

share_note: User, Oct 14: the operations@ mailbox sends at most 60 a day across both businesses; ASI plans to 45 and Jobsite to 15. The ASI Sender enforces the 60 and each share; first emails go first.
pace_note: User, Oct 15: each first email brings two follow-ups (S1, S2, S5), so a business adds about a third of its daily share in new first emails. Jobsite: at most 5 new first emails a day (share 15); ASI: 15 of 45. First emails still go first; follow-ups fill the rest, oldest first; the rest wait a day. Replaces the Oct 14 'no separate first-email cap'. The 60-a-day total is shared with ASI's mailbox.

short_sequence.note: Same short sequence as ASI batches from Oct 12: S1, S2 (+2 business days), S5 (+13).

cross_business_note: User, Oct 14: one company, one business. Jobsite and ASI keep separate repos and sessions, so the ASI Sender enforces this at send time: every manifest's do-not-contact applies to every email, and a first email is refused if anyone at that domain (not personal mail) has ever written to us or been emailed from any alias. Before drafting, also check the site's address and RN against ASI hook packets and samples if the user shares them.

footer.text: If this isn't useful, reply "no thanks" and I won't email again.

engaged_cadence.handoff: Attach the hauler PDF and set From to sites@asterfieldgroup.com; label JI/Send manually.

payment.alternative: Stripe invoice if the buyer asks
payment.required_before: first E3; the user creates it when either business secures its first pilot payment (user, Oct 14)
payment.share_only_after: hauler says yes to the E3

ramp.note: User, Oct 15 (option 1): the shared mailbox total rises about 10 a week, only if the previous 5 sending days had hard bounces under 2% of sends, no spam complaint or block notice, and no sender auto-pause. On each step day change max_total_per_day, daily_share and max_s1_per_day together, only after the user confirms the gate held. ASI changes its total the same day; the sender uses the lowest total across the day's manifests. Jobsite reports its bounce count each Friday.
